newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent heads back down, takes cues from U.S..
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent heads back down, takes cues from U.S..

text.p: IPE Brent crude futures revisited session lows in mid-afternoon trade, shortly after hitting the day's high, with NYMEX crude dictating all moves, brokers said.
"Volumes are so thin that we're just being pulled around by whatever happens in the U.S.," said one dealer.
"There's hardly anything traded at each level, so it's really unstable."
Feb Brent was trading 14 cents down at $23.56 a barrel at 1539, having touched a high of $23.90.
NYMEX futures failed to sustain an opening push to the upside, retracing early gains and moving into the red.
Jan gas oil also retraced gains to trade $1.50 down at $220.50 a tonne.
